title: Incorrect multiple equality optimization causes performance degradation
review_reason: Complete empty-table EXPLAIN reproducer. Original and developer analysis establish build-side predicate is substituted to t1.a, preventing early filter. This is plan behavior only, not wrong-result or measured performance.
required_environment: fresh isolated target-version instance; new disposable schema

oracle.reproduced: EXPLAIN left hash join has extra condition t1.a > 0 and hash build child scans t2 without t2.a > 0 filter, matching cmain. Do not infer actual measured performance degradation from empty tables.
oracle.not_reproduced: Hash build t2 includes pushed-down t2.a > 0 filter with complete execution.
oracle.unknown: Different join algorithm or error preventing exact plan comparison.

review_scope: Reproducer SQL and relevant verification/oracle comments reviewed; generated execution material crosschecked.
